title: Sheaf dg coefficient realizations and normalized arrows
statement:
Let $D\to A$ be a map of commutative rings and let $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}D$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For each commutative $D$-algebra $E$ with a specified $D$-algebra map $E\to A$, put $Y_E=Y\times_D\operatorname{Spec}E$, $p_E:Y_E\to Y$, and $\pi_E:Y_A\to Y_E$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $R_E$ to be normalization, with its shuffle product, of the standard polynomial simplicial resolution of $E/D$ [def-trf-cotangent-resolution-data, lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], normalized by [lem-sfb-simplicial-algebra-shuffle-normalization], with its evaluation augmentation $R_E\to E$ and the functorial maps $R_E\to R_A$; at $E=D$ use the constant resolution $R_D=D$. The underlying polynomial resolution is augmented quasi-isomorphically to $E$ and its normalization has flat $D$-module terms, hence is $D$-K-flat by the ordinary-module case [lem-pc-module-bounded-flat-kflat]. The underlying complex has zero positive terms, and dg multiplication and actions satisfy the signed Leibniz rule [def-sfb-dg-derived-category]. Set $\mathcal B=\mathcal O_Y\otimes_D R_A$, with total differential and multiplication.

Use the sheaf dg module conventions and localization of [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-module-localization] on the Zariski space of $Y$. A left sheaf dg $\mathcal B$-module is an integer-graded sheaf with differential $d$ and a unital associative action satisfying $d(bx)=d(b)x+(-1)^{|b|}b\,d(x)$. Let $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal B)$ be its homotopy category localized at maps inducing isomorphisms on underlying cohomology sheaves, restricted to objects whose underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-cohomology is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Shifts and cones use [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-module-localization, def-weil-triangulated-category]; in particular a homogeneous $b$ acts on the shifted module $M[k]$ by $(-1)^{k|b|}b$, and the cone is $N\oplus M[1]$ with that shifted action. Write $U$ for forgetting the dg action to $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. An object is called perfect over $\mathcal B$ if locally on $Y$ it belongs to the smallest full subcategory containing $\mathcal B$ and closed under finite sums, shifts, cones and direct summands.

For $G\in D(\mathcal O_{Y_E})$ define its coefficient realization by the relative derived tensor
$$\Phi_E(G)=R_A\otimes_{R_E}^{\mathbf L}Rp_{E*}G,$$
retaining the commuting $\mathcal O_Y$-action, and using $R_E\to E$ for the action on $Rp_{E*}G$. The tensor is the two-sided derived tensor over the constant dg algebra $R_E$; it is computed by the $D$-relative flat bar construction [lem-sfb-sheaf-dg-relative-flat-bar-extension], applied with $\mathcal S=\mathcal O_Y$, $P=R_E$, $Q=R_A$, without requiring $G$ to be $D$-flat. The affine direct image and all tensors are derived [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. For $E=D$ this is $R_A\otimes_D^{\mathbf L}G=\mathcal B\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}^{\mathbf L}G$.

For $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{Y_A})$, let $\widehat K$ be $R\pi_{D*}K$ with dg action induced by $R_A\to A$ and the given $A$-action on $K$. Here derived direct images are formed in the coefficient-linear sheaf module categories before forgetting scalars, so the $E$- and $A$-actions are retained. Thus $Rp_{E*}$ is the derived direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] along the ringed-space morphism $(Y_E,\mathcal O_{Y_E})\to(Y,p_{E*}\mathcal O_{Y_E})=(Y,\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DE)$, and $R\pi_{D*}$ the one along $(Y_A,\mathcal O_{Y_A})\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DA)$. Use the canonical composition identification $Rp_{E*}R\pi_{E*}K\simeq R\pi_{D*}K$ in $D(\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DE)$, with $R\pi_{D*}K$ restricted along $\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DE\to\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DA$: it is [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition] applied to $(Y_A,\mathcal O_{Y_A})\to(Y_E,\mathcal O_{Y_E})\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DE)$ and to $(Y_A,\mathcal O_{Y_A})\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DA)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DE)$, whose composites agree because the base triangle commutes; the second map has identity underlying space, so its direct image is the exact restriction of scalars. After further restriction along $\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DR_E\to\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DE$ it is an isomorphism of sheaf dg modules over $\mathcal O_Y\otimes_DR_E$. Given $\gamma:G\to R\pi_{E*}K$, define $\nu_E(\gamma):\Phi_E(G)\to\widehat K$ by derived extension of $Rp_{E*}\gamma$ followed by the action counit of [lem-sfb-sheaf-dg-relative-flat-bar-extension] $R_A\otimes_{R_E}^{\mathbf L}R\pi_{D*}K\to R\pi_{D*}K$. This specifies the actual counit map, not an arbitrary map with the same cohomology.

from.place: det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images, proof (3), alteration reduction through ILO X Lemma 2.2: dimension induction in the marked plurinodal input; one relative curve, de Jong Theorem 2.4, Lemmas 5.5 and 5.7, before induction on its base; replacement prerequisite: de Jong Lemma 3.7, printed p.608, including the prime-to-characteristic level-structure choice which makes the base alteration generically etale; §3.6 supplies the smooth genus-at-least-two input. This is stable pointed-curve extension, not stable modification of a specified target pair. Moduli prerequisite: projective compactification with prime-to-characteristic level structure and its universal stable family, used before taking the closure of a generic lift. Knudsen forgetful morphism as the universal stable curve. Section 1, Theorem 1.8, Corollaries 1.9 and 1.11; Section 2, Proposition 2.1 (printed pp.172--175): degree-zero logarithmic components and their section-algebra contraction. Independent prerequisite: Cohomology and log dualizing comparison for a given elementary nodal contraction. Logarithmic comparison before Knudsen Lemma 1.6: generic coherent-duality trace on a perfect marking ideal, replacing the differential-dual presentation by the same adjunction-normalized relative duality. Prerequisite for the perfect-image coherent trace comparison: locality on affine opens for the proper map between the two curve families, without asserting that this map is flat. Independent prerequisite: Pseudo-coherent perfect direct images between flat finitely presented families. Kiehl finiteness input: the unnumbered general relative-pseudo-coherence assertion following Stacks lemma-flat-proper-pseudo-coherent-direct-image-general. Finite-degree Noetherian descente input for the Kiehl finiteness assertion. Independent prerequisite: Relative sheaf descente on a prescribed Noetherian envelope. Two-open gluing prerequisite, conditional on approximation on both opens and their intersection, uniform in a supplied finite coefficient stage. Single-degree induction step: cancel finite polynomial-chart top obstructions globally while retaining the prescribed scalar-action normalization. Mayer--Vietoris subproblem for one degree: given a global coherent witness at cutoff n+1 and witnesses on two opens at cutoff n, obtain a global witness at cutoff n. The supplied global witness is part of the hypothesis. Independent input: Sheaf dg coefficient realizations and normalized arrows.

split_report.summary: Split this definition by exposing generic sheaf dg module localization, shuffle normalization, and a D-relative bar computation with its actual action counit. Reused the existing polynomial resolution theorem and bounded-above flat module K-flat theorem. Kept all coefficient realization formulas and hypotheses; made the left shift sign and coefficient-linear pushforward interpretation explicit. New prerequisites are statement-only and no Lean was written. Repaired the literal unspecified-ring-map ambiguity by requiring E to A to be a D-algebra map; the failing noncommutative base triangle is documented as STATEMENT-DISPUTED in the report.
split_report.blueprint: Serves the inherited det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images proof (3) prerequisite chain, at the global single-degree witness patching coefficient-model definition; no change to the unit route. Generic normalization and relative flat bar are below that definition. The inherited blueprint ancestor is null, as blueprint_refs.py ancestor reports.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q45-335b400c1 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: FIX: one citation fault in the item (C4); the three new nodes are accepted unchanged. Live and side-live still have the item unsplit with no repair note, and none of the new ids exists live. (1) The item's composition step Rp_{E*}Rπ_{E*}K ≃ Rπ_{D*}K cited lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition. That node gives the isomorphism only in D(O) of schemes, but ν_E needs it R_E-linearly, in the coefficient-linear categories the item itself names. Repaired in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors-basics/def-sfb-dg-coefficient-realization.json: the item now cites def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image and lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition. That lemma is applied to (Y_A,O)→(Y_E,O)→(Y,O_Y⊗E) and to (Y_A,O)→(Y,O_Y⊗A)→(Y,O_Y⊗E); the second map has identity underlying space, so its direct image is exact restriction. The two composites agree because E→A is now a D-algebra map. The unused scheme lemma was removed from stmt_deps; no cycle. (2) Checked the changes against base. The repair to 'D-algebra map' is correct: with D=E=A=Z[t] and t↦0, π_E is not over Y. Citers use D→E→A, so they are consistent. lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence correctly supplies the resolution and the augmentation-compatible maps R_E→R_A, which def-trf-cotangent-resolution-data does not assert. lem-pc-module-bounded-flat-kflat gives D-K-flatness of the direct-summand-of-polynomial terms. (3) Shuffle normalization: checked against Stacks 017V/019A/019C (D(U)=J, quotient quasi-iso, D-direct summand). The EZ shuffle formula was tested at p=q=1 (s_1x s_0y−s_0x s_1y, graded-commutative), plus the unit, constant D and the augmentation quasi-iso. (4) Sheaf dg localization def: matches sdga 0FRF/0FRI/0FS5/0FT5 with left modules. Hand-checked the Leibniz rule for the shift (−1)^{k|a|}, the cone with the shifted action, and the linearity of dh+hd. It is not a duplicate of def-sfb-dg-derived-category (right modules, Z, no sheaves). (5) Relative flat bar lemma: existence and adjunction are sdga 0FTF/0FTR with the identity topos. The bar representative is true. d² cancels with the (−1)^n convention. B(Q,P,−) preserves quasi-isos via the bar filtration, using K-flat P and Q over D. The left-deformation argument works because the cone of B(Q,P,P)→Q is acyclic and K-flat over D. The counit is a chain map, and the P=D clause holds. It is not a duplicate of lem-coef-dg-two-sided-bar-derived-tensor (Z dg categories, no S-action). (6) Batch 5: lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence is generic commutative algebra (standard resolution, Stacks 08PM). Its 562-node closure contains no trace-formula or Poincaré theorem and no nt-assume leaf. It is already a common tool, and def-trf data was cited at base. Accepted as outside both assumptions.
